rules.name: linked-selection
rules.trigger: select semantic entity in any surface
rules.effect: update shared selection; related projections highlight

rules.name: direct-parameter-manipulation
rules.effect: preview locally; commit one canonical command on end

rules.name: edit-generated-event
rules.trigger: attempt event mutation on live generated material
rules.effect: offer freeze-region or downstream-edit-operator; never mutate projection

rules.name: ab-audition-deferred
rules.effect: not part of MVP canonical architecture; prototypes must isolate override state and local history

rules.name: budget-preflight
rules.effect: show predicted count/load before commit and recovery options

rules.name: stale-result-rejection
rules.trigger: async result epoch/scope/channel/generation/input or semantic-environment digest differs
rules.effect: result may be admitted to deterministic cache only when eligible; never publish as current

rules.name: focus-surface
rules.effect: maximize surface while preserving project/selection/view state

rules.name: research-gate
rules.effect: show transparent gate and allowed previews; no false claim

rules.name: focus-without-selection
rules.trigger: keyboard focus moves across graph/timeline/canvas entity
rules.effect: move focus only; selection and expensive inspection remain unchanged until explicit select/activate

rules.name: semantic-gesture
rules.effect: begin→preview*→commit/cancel; zero or one canonical transaction and undo step

rules.name: materialize-range
rules.effect: prepare artifact asynchronously, then atomically commit only if source dependency digest still matches

rules.name: source-status
rules.effect: derive current/changed/missing/detached from source recipe and dependency digest; unrelated project edits do not stale material

rules.name: typed-edge-rewire
rules.trigger: user drags or keyboard-connects a graph edge
rules.effect: preview compiler-compatible targets; one atomic validated rewire on commit; never mutate the live graph during drag

rules.name: audio-generation-cutover
rules.trigger: committed project edit/seek/loop change produces a new plan
rules.effect: prepare new generation and atomically switch at an explicit audio time/frame; stale queues are gated

rules.name: mapping-causality
rules.trigger: mapping is placed in live context
rules.effect: reject whole-window and excessive-lookahead stages; require explicit frozen fit or declared latency

rules.name: orphaned-generated-selection
rules.effect: retain explanatory non-actionable orphan; never retarget by proximity; exact identity may reactivate only while intent epoch is unchanged
